SEARCH
Module com.mycompany.urbanlegends
Package playableCharacters

Class Character

java.lang.Object
playableCharacters.Character
All Implemented Interfaces:
CharacterFactory
Direct Known Subclasses:
Hunter, Researcher, Witch
public abstract class Character extends Object implements CharacterFactory
Abstract base class representing a playable character with core attributes such as energy, mental health, and superstition level. This class implements the CharacterFactory interface, defining the essential structure and behavior of characters in the game.

The Character class allows modification of its attributes through specific methods and provides accessor and mutator methods for these attributes.

Author:
Jorge Rojas, Ismael Marchena, Fabian Arguedas, Joxan Portilla, Melani Barrantes
